# Introduction

This report imports the adjusted ANCOVA results from three analyses:

1. **All ANCOVA** (`metformin_all_data_ancova_model_results_tables.rds`) — Treatment effect adjusted for baseline, Site, age, nonverbal IQ, and sex.
2. **Age Group Interaction ANCOVA** (`metformin_all_data_age_interaction_ancova_model_results_tables.rds`) — Treatment effect stratified by Age 6-11 vs. Age 12+.
3. **Molecular Category Interaction ANCOVA** (`metformin_molecular_interaction_ancova_model_results_tables.rds`) — Treatment effect stratified by Full vs. Mosaic methylation.

```{r}
#| label: load-results
#| include: false

ancova_results <- readRDS(
  "metformin_all_data_ancova_model_results_tables.rds"
)
age_results    <- readRDS(
  "metformin_all_data_age_interaction_ancova_model_results_tables.rds"
)
mol_results    <- readRDS(
  "metformin_molecular_interaction_ancova_model_results_tables.rds"
)

# Instruments to include in combined summary (CGI excluded per reporting convention)
instruments <- c(
  "ELS", "BMI", "ABC", "ADAMS", "PedsQL", "CSHQ",
  "SNAP-IV", "VAS", "Vineland", "Biomarkers", "Toolbox", "Eye Tracking"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: build-summary-table
#| include: false

# --- Pooled results ---
pooled_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(instruments, function(inst) {
    ancova_results[[inst]] |>
      dplyr::select(Outcome, n_p, n_m, contrast_mean, contrast_ci, contrast_p) |>
      dplyr::mutate(Instrument = inst, .before = 1) |> 
      dplyr::filter(
        !(
          Instrument == "Vineland" & stringr::str_detect(Outcome, "Scale Score")
          )
      )
  })
) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Outcome = ifelse(
      Outcome == "Written  Raw Score",
      "Written Raw Score",
      Outcome
    )
  )

# --- Age interaction results: pivot to one row per outcome ---
age_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(instruments, function(inst) {
    age_results[[inst]] |>
      dplyr::select(
        Outcome, strata_label,
        contrast_mean, contrast_ci, interaction_p
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(Instrument = inst, .before = 1)
  })
) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Instrument, Outcome, interaction_p),
    names_from = strata_label,
    values_from = c(contrast_mean, contrast_ci),
    names_glue = "{strata_label}_{.value}"
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    age_interaction_p    = interaction_p,
    contrast_mean_age611 = `Age 6-11_contrast_mean`,
    contrast_ci_age611   = `Age 6-11_contrast_ci`,
    contrast_mean_age12  = `Age 12+_contrast_mean`,
    contrast_ci_age12    = `Age 12+_contrast_ci`
  )

# --- Molecular interaction results: pivot to one row per outcome ---
mol_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(instruments, function(inst) {
    mol_results[[inst]] |>
      dplyr::select(
        Outcome, strata_label,
        contrast_mean, contrast_ci, interaction_p
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(Instrument = inst, .before = 1)
  })
) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Instrument, Outcome, interaction_p),
    names_from = strata_label,
    values_from = c(contrast_mean, contrast_ci),
    names_glue = "{strata_label}_{.value}"
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    mol_interaction_p    = interaction_p,
    contrast_mean_full   = Full_contrast_mean,
    contrast_ci_full     = Full_contrast_ci,
    contrast_mean_mosaic = Mosaic_contrast_mean,
    contrast_ci_mosaic   = Mosaic_contrast_ci
  )

# --- Join all three and reorder columns ---
summary_tbl <- pooled_tbl |>
  dplyr::left_join(age_tbl, by = c("Instrument", "Outcome")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(mol_tbl, by = c("Instrument", "Outcome")) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Instrument, Outcome,
    n_p, n_m,
    contrast_mean, contrast_ci, contrast_p,
    contrast_mean_age611, contrast_ci_age611,
    contrast_mean_age12, contrast_ci_age12,
    age_interaction_p,
    contrast_mean_full, contrast_ci_full,
    contrast_mean_mosaic, contrast_ci_mosaic,
    mol_interaction_p
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: forest-data-prep
#| include: false

flipped_labs <- c("Metformin", "Placebo")
# pivot summary table to long format for forest plot
forest_data <- summary_tbl |>
  dplyr::select(
    Instrument, Outcome,
    contrast_mean, contrast_ci,
    contrast_mean_age611, contrast_ci_age611,
    contrast_mean_age12, contrast_ci_age12
    # contrast_mean_full, contrast_ci_full,
    # contrast_mean_mosaic, contrast_ci_mosaic
  ) |> 
  dplyr::rename(
    all_mean = contrast_mean,
    all_ci   = contrast_ci,
    age611_mean = contrast_mean_age611,
    age611_ci   = contrast_ci_age611,
    age12_mean = contrast_mean_age12,
    age12_ci   = contrast_ci_age12
    # full_mean  = contrast_mean_full,
    # full_ci    = contrast_ci_full,
    # mosaic_mean = contrast_mean_mosaic,
    # mosaic_ci   = contrast_ci_mosaic
  ) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(dplyr::ends_with("_mean"), 
             dplyr::ends_with("_ci")),
    names_to = c("Analysis", ".value"),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Analysis = dplyr::case_when(
      Analysis == "all"    ~ "All",
      Analysis == "age611" ~ "Age 6-11",
      Analysis == "age12"  ~ "Age 12+"
      # Analysis == "full"   ~ "Full",
      # Analysis == "mosaic" ~ "Mosaic",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Instrument = factor(Instrument, levels = instruments),
    ci_split = gsub("[()]", "", ci)
  ) |> 
  tidyr::separate(
    ci_split, into = c("low", "hi"), sep = ","
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    # convert estimates and conf ints to numeric
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = c(mean, low, hi),
      .fns = ~ as.numeric(.x)
    ),
    # determine significance using conf int
    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      (low < 0 & hi < 0) | (low > 0 & hi > 0) ~ "Yes",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),
    # remove NDW50 from outcome
    Outcome = gsub(" NDW50", "", Outcome)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    any.sig = ifelse(any(sig == "Yes"), "Yes", "No"),
    .by = c(Instrument, Outcome)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::rename(
    Estimate = mean
  )

forest_data_all <- forest_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(Analysis == "All")
forest_data_stratified <- forest_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(Analysis != "All")

## Main analysis ##
forest_primary_all <- forest_data_all |>
  dplyr::filter(Instrument == "ELS") |>
  dplyr::select(Instrument, Outcome, Analysis, Estimate, low, hi) |> 
  plot_composite_forest(grouped = FALSE)

forest_primary_stratified <- forest_data_stratified |>
  dplyr::filter(Instrument == "ELS") |>
  dplyr::select(Instrument, Outcome, Analysis, Estimate, low, hi) |> 
  plot_composite_forest()
## Secondary analyses ##
forest_abc <- forest_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    Instrument %in% c("ABC"), any.sig == "Yes"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Instrument, Outcome, Analysis, Estimate, low, hi) |>
  plot_composite_forest(arrow_labs = flipped_labs)

forest_adams <- forest_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    Instrument %in% c("ADAMS"), any.sig == "Yes"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Outcome = gsub(" Total", "", Outcome)
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(Instrument, Outcome, Analysis, Estimate, low, hi) |>
  plot_composite_forest(arrow_labs = flipped_labs)

forest_pql <- forest_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    Instrument %in% c("PedsQL"), any.sig == "Yes"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Instrument, Outcome, Analysis, Estimate, low, hi) |>
  plot_composite_forest()

forest_cshq <- forest_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    Instrument %in% c("CSHQ"), any.sig == "Yes"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Instrument, Outcome, Analysis, Estimate, low, hi) |>
  plot_composite_forest(arrow_labs = flipped_labs)

forest_vas <- forest_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    Instrument %in% c("VAS"), any.sig == "Yes"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Instrument, Outcome, Analysis, Estimate, low, hi) |>
  plot_composite_forest()

forest_vabs <- forest_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    Instrument %in% c("Vineland"), any.sig == "Yes"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Instrument, Outcome, Analysis, Estimate, low, hi) |>
  plot_composite_forest()

forest_eyetracking <- forest_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    Instrument %in% c("Eye Tracking")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Instrument, Outcome, Analysis, Estimate, low, hi) |>
  plot_composite_forest()

forest_toolbox <- forest_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    Instrument %in% c("Toolbox"), any.sig == "Yes"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Instrument, Outcome, Analysis, Estimate, low, hi) |>
  plot_composite_forest()

forest_bmi <- forest_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    Instrument %in% c("BMI"), any.sig == "Yes"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Instrument, Outcome, Analysis, Estimate, low, hi) |>
  plot_composite_forest(arrow_labs = flipped_labs)
```

Forest plots show estimated 16-week treatment effect differences between Metformin and placebo groups across (A) all randomized participants and (B) age-stratified (Age 6-11, Age 12+) and molecular-category-stratified (Full Methylation, Mosaic Methylation) subgroups. Data are presented for the LS mean difference and its 95% CI between Metformin and placebo on change from baseline and week 16."

forest_primary <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  forest_primary_all,
  forest_primary_stratified,
  ncol = 1,
  align = "hv",
  labels = c("A)", "B)")
)

forest_primary
